description: Search a user's Box (cloud storage) account for files and folders matching a query string across names and content. Optionally restrict to only files or only folders. Returns matching items with id, type, name, size, and last-modified time. Use to find documents by keyword.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 30, max 200).

query.description: Free-text search query matched against Box file and folder names and content.

type.description: Optional filter: restrict results to "file" or "folder".

name: box_search
title: Box Search
